title: Year of The Dragon, 1 dollar
descriptionPlain: Description Lucky charm for the coming year Continuation of the best-selling series The perfect gift to express wishes for prosperity Symbol of development, life energy and positive change According to the Chinese calendar, from 10 February 2024 to 28 January 2025, the reigning sign will be the Wood Dragon, one of the most fortunate and powerful signs in the entire horoscope. It symbolizes strength, energy and all prosperity, and the element of wood emphasizes additional embodiment of growth.
